title: White Linen Sleeveless V-Neck Midi Dress with Button Front & Pleated Skirt
description:
Easy, elegant and made for warm days – a pure linen sleeveless midi dress with a soft V-neckline, a full row of silver-tone buttons and a fitted bodice that opens into a softly pleated skirt. Pair it with a sun hat and a woven bag for holidays, garden parties, brunch and summer weddings.

✦ The Details
• Pure linen midi dress with a cotton lining
• V-neckline, sleeveless
• Full front button placket with silver-tone buttons
• Fitted bodice with darts and a seamed waist
• Box-pleated A-line skirt for easy movement
• Midi length

✦ Fabric & Craft
Made from pure linen with a soft cotton lining, so it stays breathable and is never see-through. Linen gets softer with every wash and creases naturally – that relaxed texture is part of its charm. Stitched in our own Jaipur unit.

✦ Fit & Size
Fitted through the bodice with a flowing pleated skirt. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
A wide-brim straw hat, pearl drop earrings and a rattan box bag for a holiday look. Clear block heels and a woven clutch for brunch. Add a light cardigan or denim jacket for cooler evenings.

✦ Shade Card – Choose Your Colour
Shown in white. Pick White, Ivory, Beige, Sage Green, Sky Blue, Blush Pink or Black from the shade card and we will stitch this exact dress in your colour – same price. Colours other than white are made to order and dispatch in 5–7 working days.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
set_items: Midi Dress (pure linen with cotton lining)
care: Gentle hand wash or machine wash cold on a delicate cycle. Dry in shade. Iron while slightly damp on medium heat.
